% Pattern: env/newtheorem/article. The title, not the name, gives the kind.
% want prop-1 statement/lemma 1
% want thm-1 definition 2
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{prop}{Lemma}
\newtheorem{thm}[prop]{Definition}
\begin{document}
\begin{prop}
A lemma in an environment called prop.
\end{prop}
\begin{thm}
A definition in an environment called thm.
\end{thm}
\end{document}
